debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r l-a-u-n-c-h-e-d a s-c-a-n of the f-a-c-i-a-l d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e and l-e-f-t a q-u-e-r-y t-r-a-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d a f-a-l-s-e f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e and l-e-f-t an e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-l-a-y-e-d s-t-o-l-e-n c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s to g-a-i-n e-n-t-r-y and l-e-f-t a s-e-s-s-i-o-n l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l c-h-e-c-k
4) the a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d the t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p s-t-a-m-p-s in the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g-s and l-e-f-t a f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c m-a-r-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the h-a-s-h v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d the e-v-e-n-t-s to an a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e and l-e-f-t a b-l-u-e c-o-l-r r-e-d-f-l-a-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w
